description: Check shell scripts for syntax errors with `bash -n` and return structured diagnostics (file, line, message). Parses without executing, so it is safe on untrusted scripts. Reports valid:true when no errors are found.

detailLevel.description: Item preset: summary 20, normal 100, full (default; also skips the response budget)

files.description: Required. Shell script path(s) to check; a string or array

name: bash_syntax_check
title: Bash syntax check (structured)
